title: IVG Pro Salts Spearmint 10ml E-Liquid
description: IVG Pro Nic Salts Spearmint 10ml E-Liquid provides a superbly smooth and traditional cooling experience. This straightforward recipe perfectly replicates the slightly sweet, floral, and highly aromatic characteristics of natural Spearmint. Unlike harsher menthol options, this profile offers a gentle, rolling coolness that refreshes the mouth while maintaining a delicately sugary finish, serving as a brilliant everyday palate cleanser. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. IVG Pro Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits, serving as a highly cost-effective alternative to single-use or prefilled systems. The IVG Pro Salts collection takes the globally revered flavour profiles from the beloved IVG Pro prefilled pod range and makes them available in convenient 10ml bottles. As a multi-award-winning UK brand, IVG ensures exceptional quality across a massive selection of e-liquids. Beyond the botanical freshness of Spearmint, vapers can explore other standout options such as the tangy citrus of Purple Lemonade or the sweet nostalgia of Hub Blast, ensuring a premium choice for every preference.
